ideas.title: The $9B Somali fraud scandal: A deeper dive
ideas.description: Investigate the $9B Somali fraud scandal, including the involvement of Minnesota Gov Walz and AG Ellison.
ideas.angle: Follow the money and investigate potential corruption
questions: What was the extent of the fraud?
ideas.insight: The $9B Somali fraud scandal has significant implications for Minnesota and the country. Investigating this scandal could uncover a larger web of corruption and wrongdoing.
